correctness.rationale: For all lambda≠0,1, a Jacobian-rank argument proves smoothness and Koszul/adjunction gives genus ten. The ten-dimensional Hasse–Witt matrix coefficient formula is reconstructed explicitly; an exact standard-library computation confirms exactly six entries. Their three 2×2 blocks have paired zeros only at -1,2,3. They are otherwise invertible as semilinear Frobenius blocks. Consequently the stable Frobenius rank equals the matrix rank and is 6 or 4, while a=10-rank equals 4 or 6. The claims are geometric, not inferred from testing finite fields.
